-- Retained production bodies for the 2026-10-23 desktop operation-count baseline.
-- No FPS or native secure/rendering result is implied. Loaded as Lua data by idle_hud.lua.
return {
    clock = [==[
    self._infoBarFrame = infoBar
    if not self._clockTicker and C_Timer and C_Timer.NewTicker then
        local function _tickClock()
            if self.InfoBar and self.InfoBar.TimeText and C_DateAndTime and C_DateAndTime.GetCurrentCalendarTime then
                local date = C_DateAndTime.GetCurrentCalendarTime()
                local hour, minute = date and date.hour, date and date.minute
                if hour and minute then
                    self.InfoBar.TimeText:SetText(string.format("%02d:%02d", hour, minute))
                end
            end
        end
        _tickClock()
        self._clockTicker = C_Timer.NewTicker(1, _tickClock)
    end
    
]==],
    marquee = [==[
function FluxMinimap:ApplyInfoBarZoneTextFit(fullText, r, g, b)
    local ib = self.InfoBar
    if not ib or not ib.ZoneText then return end
    ib._fullZoneText = fullText or ""
    ib._lastZoneR, ib._lastZoneG, ib._lastZoneB = r, g, b
    local w = ib:GetWidth()
    if not w or w <= 0 then
        w = CONFIG.Size
    end
    local maxWidth = math.max(1, w - ZONE_TEXT_PAD_LEFT - ZONE_TEXT_PAD_RIGHT)
    local ft = ib.ZoneText
    local clip = ib.ZoneScrollClip
    if clip then
        clip:SetWidth(maxWidth)
    end
    ib._zoneScrollActive = false
    ib._zoneScrollPos = nil
    ib._zoneScrollDir = nil
    ft:ClearAllPoints()
    if clip then
        ft:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", clip, "TOPLEFT", 0, 0)
        ft:SetPoint("BOTTOMLEFT", clip, "BOTTOMLEFT", 0, 0)
    else
        ft:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", ib, "TOPLEFT", ZONE_TEXT_PAD_LEFT, 0)
        ft:SetPoint("BOTTOMLEFT", ib, "BOTTOMLEFT", ZONE_TEXT_PAD_LEFT, 0)
    end
    ft:SetWidth(maxWidth)
    local _, truncated = TruncateFontStringToWidth(ft, fullText or "", maxWidth)
    ib._zoneTextTruncated = truncated
    ft:SetTextColor(r, g, b)
end

function FluxMinimap:OnInfoBarZoneHitEnter()
    local ib = self.InfoBar
    if not ib or not ib.ZoneText or not ib.ZoneScrollClip then return end
    if not ib._fullZoneText or ib._fullZoneText == "" then return end
    local clip = ib.ZoneScrollClip
    local ft = ib.ZoneText
    local clipW = clip:GetWidth()
    if not clipW or clipW <= 0 then return end
    ft:SetText(ib._fullZoneText)
    if ft.SetWidth then
        ft:SetWidth(0)
    end
    local fullW = ft:GetStringWidth()
    -- Scroll whenever the full label is wider than the clip (not only when ellipsis was used).
    if fullW <= clipW + 1 then
        return
    end
    ib._zoneScrollActive = true
    ib._zoneScrollPos = 0
    ib._zoneScrollDir = -1
    ft:ClearAllPoints()
    ft:SetPoint("LEFT", clip, "LEFT", 0, 0)
    local r, g, b = ib._lastZoneR or 1, ib._lastZoneG or 1, ib._lastZoneB or 1
    ft:SetTextColor(r, g, b)

    -- Flux perf T2.7: attach the marquee OnUpdate only while scrolling is active.
    local bar = self._infoBarFrame
    if bar then
        bar:SetScript("OnUpdate", function(_, elapsed)
            self:UpdateInfoBarZoneScroll(elapsed)
        end)
    end
end

function FluxMinimap:OnInfoBarZoneHitLeave()
    local ib = self.InfoBar
    if not ib then return end
    if ib._zoneScrollActive then
        ib._zoneScrollActive = false
        ib._zoneScrollPos = nil
        ib._zoneScrollDir = nil
    end
    -- Flux perf T2.7: detach the marquee OnUpdate when no longer needed.
    local bar = self._infoBarFrame
    if bar then
        bar:SetScript("OnUpdate", nil)
    end
    self:UpdateInfoBarZone()
end

function FluxMinimap:UpdateInfoBarZoneScroll(elapsed)
    local ib = self.InfoBar
    if not ib or not ib._zoneScrollActive or not ib.ZoneText or not ib.ZoneScrollClip then return end
    local clip = ib.ZoneScrollClip
    local ft = ib.ZoneText
    local clipW = clip:GetWidth()
    if not clipW or clipW <= 0 then return end
    ft:SetText(ib._fullZoneText or "")
    if ft.SetWidth then
        ft:SetWidth(0)
    end
    local fullW = ft:GetStringWidth()
    local maxScroll = math.max(0, fullW - clipW)
    if maxScroll <= 0 then
        ib._zoneScrollActive = false
        ib._zoneScrollPos = nil
        ib._zoneScrollDir = nil
        -- Flux perf T2.7: zone now fits; stop the marquee OnUpdate.
        local bar = self._infoBarFrame
        if bar then
            bar:SetScript("OnUpdate", nil)
        end
        self:UpdateInfoBarZone()
        return
    end
    local pos = ib._zoneScrollPos or 0
    local dir = ib._zoneScrollDir or -1
    pos = pos + dir * ZONE_SCROLL_PX_PER_SEC * elapsed
    if pos > 0 then
        pos = 0
        ib._zoneScrollDir = -1
    elseif pos < -maxScroll then
        pos = -maxScroll
        ib._zoneScrollDir = 1
    end
    ib._zoneScrollPos = pos
    ft:ClearAllPoints()
    ft:SetPoint("LEFT", clip, "LEFT", pos, 0)
    local r, g, b = ib._lastZoneR or 1, ib._lastZoneG or 1, ib._lastZoneB or 1
    ft:SetTextColor(r, g, b)
end

function FluxMinimap:RefreshInfoBarZoneFit()
    self:UpdateInfoBarZone()
end

function FluxMinimap:UpdateInfoBarZone()
    if not self.InfoBar then return end

    local zoneName = GetZoneText() or ""
    local subZoneName = GetSubZoneText() or ""
    local fullText
    if subZoneName ~= "" and subZoneName ~= zoneName then
        fullText = zoneName .. " - " .. subZoneName
    else
        fullText = zoneName
    end

    local pvpType
    if C_PvP and C_PvP.GetZonePVPInfo then
        pvpType = C_PvP.GetZonePVPInfo()
    elseif GetZonePVPInfo then
        pvpType = GetZonePVPInfo()
    end
    local r, g, b = 1, 1, 1
    if pvpType == "sanctuary" then
        r, g, b = 0.41, 0.8, 0.94
    elseif pvpType == "arena" then
        r, g, b = 1, 0.1, 0.1
    elseif pvpType == "friendly" then
        r, g, b = 0.1, 1, 0.1
    elseif pvpType == "hostile" then
        r, g, b = 1, 0.1, 0.1
    elseif pvpType == "contested" then
        r, g, b = 1, 0.7, 0
    end
    self:ApplyInfoBarZoneTextFit(fullText, r, g, b)
end

]==],
    statCache = [==[
function _RebuildTooltipStatFrameCache()
    _tooltipKeyToStatFrame = {}
    _tooltipKeyToStatFrameList = {}
    _tooltipKeyToStatFrameAt = GetTime() or 0
    local function registerStatKey(c, key)
        key = _CanonicalIlvlGsRegistryKey(key) or key
        key = InfoFrame._CamelotCombatStatKey(key)
        if not key or not c then return end
        if not _tooltipKeyToStatFrame[key] then
            _tooltipKeyToStatFrame[key] = c
        end
        local L = _tooltipKeyToStatFrameList[key]
        if not L then
            L = {}
            _tooltipKeyToStatFrameList[key] = L
        end
        for i = 1, #L do
            if L[i] == c then return end
        end
        L[#L + 1] = c
    end
    local pane = _G.CharacterStatsPane
    if pane and pane.statsFramePool then
        for statFrame in pane.statsFramePool:EnumerateActive() do
            registerStatKey(statFrame, statFrame._FluxInfoStatKey)
        end
    end
    local foreverRoot = _G.CharacterStatsPaneScrollBox
    if foreverRoot and foreverRoot ~= _G.CharacterStatsPanePetScrollBox then
        local box = foreverRoot.ScrollBox
        local view = box and box.GetView and box:GetView()
        local frames = view and view.GetFrames and view:GetFrames()
        if type(frames) == "table" then
            for i = 1, #frames do
                local f = frames[i]
                if f then
                    registerStatKey(f, f._FluxInfoStatKey)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local root = _G.CharacterFrame or pane
    if root and root.GetChildren then
        local queue = { root }
        local qi = 1
        while qi <= #queue do
            local node = queue[qi]
            qi = qi + 1
            if node and node.GetChildren then
                local kids = { node:GetChildren() }
                for i = 1, #kids do
                    local c = kids[i]
                    if c then
                        queue[#queue + 1] = c
                        registerStatKey(c, c._FluxInfoStatKey)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

]==],
    statResolver = [==[
function InfoFrame.ResolveStatFramesForTooltip(statKey, allowRetry)
    statKey = _CanonicalIlvlGsRegistryKey(statKey) or statKey
    statKey = InfoFrame._CamelotCombatStatKey(statKey)
    if not statKey then return {} end
    if allowRetry == nil then allowRetry = true end
    local now = GetTime() or 0
    if (now - (_tooltipKeyToStatFrameAt or 0)) > 0.25 then
        _RebuildTooltipStatFrameCache()
    end
    local seen = {}
    local out = {}
    local function addFrame(f)
        if not f or seen[f] then return end
        seen[f] = true
        out[#out + 1] = f
    end
    local L = _tooltipKeyToStatFrameList[statKey]
    if type(L) == "table" then
        for i = 1, #L do
            addFrame(L[i])
        end
    end
    local one = _tooltipKeyToStatFrame[statKey]
    if one then
        addFrame(one)
    end

    local function resolvedKeyForFrame(c)
        local k = c._FluxInfoStatKey
        if k then
            return InfoFrame._CamelotCombatStatKey(_CanonicalIlvlGsRegistryKey(k) or k)
        end
        if FLUX_API and FLUX_API.isRetail then
            k = GetRetailStatKey(c)
        end
        if not k then
            k = GetClassicStatKey(c)
        end
        return InfoFrame._CamelotCombatStatKey(_CanonicalIlvlGsRegistryKey(k) or k)
    end

    local qSeen = {}
    local q = {}
    local function push(x)
        if x and not qSeen[x] then
            qSeen[x] = true
            q[#q + 1] = x
        end
    end
    push(_G.CharacterFrame)
    push(_G.CharacterStatsPane)
    push(_G.PaperDollFrame)
    push(_G.CharacterStatsPaneScrollBox)
    local qi = 1
    while qi <= #q do
        local node = q[qi]
        qi = qi + 1
        local _, labelText = _GetStatLabelRegionAndText(node)
        if labelText and _StatFrameHasValueRegion(node) then
            if resolvedKeyForFrame(node) == statKey then
                addFrame(node)
            end
        end
        if node.GetChildren then
            local kids = { node:GetChildren() }
            for i = 1, #kids do
                push(kids[i])
            end
        end
    end

    table.sort(out, function(a, b)
        local sa = (a.IsShown and a:IsShown()) and 1 or 0
        local sb = (b.IsShown and b:IsShown()) and 1 or 0
        if sa ~= sb then
            return sa > sb
        end
        return tostring(a) < tostring(b)
    end)

    if #out == 0 and allowRetry and (now - (_lastTooltipCacheFlushPinsAt or 0)) > 0.2 then
        _lastTooltipCacheFlushPinsAt = now
        if type(RefreshAllPinIndicators) == "function" then
            RefreshAllPinIndicators()
        end
        _tooltipKeyToStatFrameAt = 0
        _RebuildTooltipStatFrameCache()
        return InfoFrame.ResolveStatFramesForTooltip(statKey, false)
    end
    return out
end

]==],
    colorHelper = [==[
local function _GetSpellPowerTopSchoolColorNoTie()
    local cscFn = _G.CSC_InfoFrame_BuildSpellPowerData
    if type(cscFn) == "function" then
        local ok, maxDmg, _, _, values, relevant = pcall(cscFn)
        if ok and type(maxDmg) == "number" and maxDmg > 0 and type(values) == "table" and type(relevant) == "table" then
            local topCount = 0
            local topSchool = nil
            for school = 2, 7 do
                if relevant[school] and type(values[school]) == "number" and values[school] == maxDmg then
                    topCount = topCount + 1
                    topSchool = school
                end
            end
            if topCount == 1 then
                return _SCHOOL_COLOR_BY_ID[topSchool]
            end
            return nil -- tie or no clear top -> white
        end
    end
    if InfoFrame._ClassicSpellDamageColorHex then
        return InfoFrame._ClassicSpellDamageColorHex()
    end
    return nil
end

]==],
    color = [==[
function InfoFrame._ClassicSpellDamageColorHex()
    local maxD, _, _, bonus = InfoFrame._CamelotSpellBonus()
    local tops = {}
    for school = 2, 7 do
        if bonus[school] == maxD then
            tops[#tops + 1] = school
        end
    end
    if #tops == 1 then
        return _SCHOOL_COLOR_BY_ID[tops[1]] or "ffffff"
    end
    local _, _, classId = UnitClass("player")
    local tab
    if type(GetNumTalentTabs) == "function" and type(GetTalentTabInfo) == "function" then
        local best, bestPts = nil, -1
        for i = 1, GetNumTalentTabs() do
            local _, _, pts = GetTalentTabInfo(i)
            pts = tonumber(pts) or 0
            if pts > bestPts then
                bestPts = pts
                best = i
            end
        end
        if bestPts > 0 then
            tab = best
        end
    end
    local dominant
    if classId == 8 then
        if tab == 1 then dominant = 7 elseif tab == 2 then dominant = 3 elseif tab == 3 then dominant = 5 end
    elseif classId == 5 then
        if tab == 2 then dominant = 2 elseif tab == 3 then dominant = 6 end
    elseif classId == 9 then
        if tab == 1 then dominant = 6 elseif tab == 3 then dominant = 3 end
    elseif classId == 2 then
        if tab == 1 then dominant = 2 end
    elseif classId == 11 then
        if tab == 1 then dominant = 4 end
    elseif classId == 7 then
        if tab == 1 then dominant = 4 end
    end
    if dominant then
        for i = 1, #tops do
            if tops[i] == dominant then
                return _SCHOOL_COLOR_BY_ID[dominant] or "ffffff"
            end
        end
    end
    return "ffffff"
end

]==],
    spellLine = [==[
STAT_REGISTRY["spellPower"] = {
    label = "Spell",
    order = 50,
    -- getText returns (fullText, compactText) so the combined Dmg / Heal line
    -- can be formatted and colored before _GetKeyText sees it.
    getText = function()
        if InfoFrame._UseClassicSpellPowerLine() then
            -- Forever Spell Damage / Spell Healing are Classic Era spell power.
            -- Pin damage -> S.P.  Pin healing -> Heal.  Pin both -> Spell: dmg / heal.
            local mode = GetInfoFrameCharDB().spellDisplayMode or "off"
            local maxD, heal, _, bonus = InfoFrame._CamelotSpellBonus()
            local haveSchools = false
            for school = 2, 7 do
                if bonus[school] ~= nil then
                    haveSchools = true
                    break
                end
            end
            local snap = InfoFrame._camelotSpellSnapshot
            local dmgHex = _GetSpellPowerTopSchoolColorNoTie() or "ffffff"
            local dmgStr
            if haveSchools or not (snap and type(snap.shownText) == "string" and snap.shownText ~= "") then
                dmgStr = string.format("|cff%s%d|r", dmgHex, maxD or 0)
            else
                dmgStr = snap.shownText
            end
            local healStr
            if heal ~= 0 or not (snap and type(snap.healText) == "string" and snap.healText ~= "") then
                healStr = string.format("|cff20ff20%d|r", heal or 0)
            else
                healStr = "|cff20ff20" .. snap.healText .. "|r"
            end
            local showDmg = mode == "sp" or mode == "both"
            local showHeal = mode == "heal" or mode == "both"
            if showDmg and showHeal then
                local full = "Spell: " .. dmgStr .. " / " .. healStr
                local compact = "Spell: " .. dmgStr .. "/" .. healStr
                return full, compact
            end
            if showHeal then
                local one = "Heal: " .. healStr
                return one, one
            end
            local one = "S.P.: " .. dmgStr
            return one, one
        end
        local cscFn = _G.CSC_InfoFrame_BuildSpellPowerData
        if type(cscFn) == "function" then
            local ok, maxDmg, heal, _, values, relevant = pcall(cscFn)
            if ok and type(maxDmg) == "number" and maxDmg > 0 then
                local colorFn = _G.CSC_InfoFrame_GetDisplayColorForTop
                local colorHex = "ffffff"
                if type(colorFn) == "function" then
                    colorHex = _NormalizeHexColor(colorFn(values, relevant, maxDmg, false)) or "ffffff"
                end
                local dmgStr  = string.format("|cff%s%d|r", colorHex, maxDmg)
                if type(heal) == "number" and heal > 0 then
                    local healStr = string.format("|cff20ff20%d|r", heal)
                    local full    = "Spell: " .. dmgStr .. " / " .. healStr
                    local compact = "Spell: " .. dmgStr .. "/" .. healStr
                    return full, compact
                end
                local one = "Spell: " .. dmgStr
                return one, one
            end
        end
        -- Retail / fallback: best school damage only.
        if type(GetSpellBonusDamage) == "function" then
            local best = 0
            for i = 2, 7 do
                local v = _SafeCall(GetSpellBonusDamage, i)
                if v and v > best then best = v end
            end
            if best > 0 then
                local s = string.format("|cffffffff%d|r", best)
                local one = "Spell: " .. s
                return one, one
            end
        end
        local na = "|cff888888--|r"
        local one = "Spell: " .. na
        return one, one
    end,
    get = function() return nil end,
    fmt = "%d",
}

]==],
}
